title: 900栋老别墅的小岛，把咖啡馆开进百年洋楼 | Coffee in Gulangyu ☕
description:
你会为了一栋老房子，专门走进一家咖啡馆吗？评论区告诉我。

厦门鼓浪屿，一座不到两平方公里的小岛，却留着九百多栋中西合璧的老别墅。2017 年，「鼓浪屿：历史国际社区」列入《世界遗产名录》，是中国第 52 项世界遗产，全岛现存历史建筑九百多座。如今，很多老洋楼变成了咖啡馆——海风、旧钢琴、一杯慢慢滴落的手冲。闽南人会说一句「好呷」(hó-tsia̍h)，就是好喝、好吃。慢下来，本身就是这座岛的味道。

Gulangyu, an islet under two square kilometres off Xiamen, holds more than 900 East-meets-West villas. In 2017 "Gulangyu: A Historic International Settlement" was inscribed on the World Heritage List as China's 52nd site, with over 900 historic buildings surviving. Many of the old mansions are now cafés — sea breeze, an old piano, a slow pour-over. In the Minnan tongue you'd say hó-tsia̍h — tasty. On this island, slowing down is the whole point.

Facts only, no endorsement. AI-assisted edit; the subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
